/bde ba gang phyir mi shes pas/ /rtag tu rang bzhin bde ba can/ /'jig rten khams ni gang du yang / /sangs rgyas gzhan du rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan du med/ /gdol ba smyig mkhan la sogs pa/ /gsod don don du sems pa po/ /de rnams kyai rdo rje shes na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the rtsom med/ /byis pa mi shes pas bsgribs pa/ /'di yi 'gro ba mi shes pa/ /'gro ba drug gi srid pa'i mthar/ /gang zhig rmongs pa 'khor bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying po snying rje che/ /kyai yi rdo rje'i thabs rnyed pas/ /gang zhig yul rnams rnam sbyong ba/ /de ni bla med rnyed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ sa ni puk+ka sīr bshad pa/ /gang phyir gti mug sra ba nyid/ /sku ni rnam snang nyid gsungs pa/ /ji ltar mi bskyod phyag rgya lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sems spangs nas ni lus kyis ni/ /mdzes pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir rnam par snang mdzad sems/ /sku la thugs kyi phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ chu khams ri khrod mar bshad pa/ /mi bskyod khu ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /gtso bo mi bskyod phyag rgyas ni/ /ri khrod ma la phyag rgyar rigs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ /lus spangs nas ni sems kyis ni/ /gnas pa gzhan du mthong mi 'gyur/ /de phyir sems ni gti mug 'gyur/ /thugs la gti mug phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ me ni gdol pa mor bshad pa/ /'dod chags phyag rgyas gdol pa mo/ /rigs te phyag rgya gzhan min na/ /ji ltar rin chen phyag rgya lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gang phyir 'dod chags khrag bshad pa/ /khrag ni rin chen 'byung ldan nyid/ /drod ni khrag gi rang bzhin phyir/ /'dod chags ser sna'i phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ gang phyir g.yung mo rlung nyid de/

/don yod rlung gi gzugs can nyid/ /don yod phyag rgyas g.yung mo la/ /gtso bo phyag rgyar rigs par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'dod chags ma gtogs phrag dog ni/ /gzhan du 'byung ba ma yin te/ /de phyir 'dod chags phyag rgya yis/ /mkhas pas g.yung mo phyag rgyas gdab/ /gang phyir gzugs ni sra ba nyid/ /dkar mo snang mdzad gsungs pa nyid/ /sngar gsungs nyid kyi rim pa yis/ /sems kyi bdag pos phyag rgyas gdab/ /de yi rigs pas chom rkun ma/ /de bzhin ro langs ma nyid dang / /de yi rigs pas ghasma rī/ /ma logs pa las phyag rgya 'o/ /kyai yi rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /snyoms 'jug gnas pa'i lha nyid la/ /sems can don phyir gtor ma che/ /de la bdag med mas zhus pa/ /e wam̐ rnam par bzhugs nas ni/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa las/ /sems can rnams kyi srog bsrung phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpas gtor ma bstan/ /om̐ in+d+ra dza ma dza la dzak+kha/ bhu ta bah+ni bā u rak+kha tsan+d+ra sudz+dza mā da pap+pa ta la pā tā le aṭa ṭha sap+pa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñja dzi gha phul+la dhup+pa māṃ sa piṃ gha/ am+bha sap+pa kadz+dza sā dha khan+ti khu ṇi be ḍa gā da/ om̐ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dhar+m+mā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twā ta/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ gal te 'di'i gtor mas 'byung po thams cad mchod par byed na rnal 'byor pa rnams legs par 'gyur te/ de rnams la bde ba dri ma med pa dang / lha mo rnams dang / 'gro ba rab tu 'byor ba rnams dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'dis 'byung po'i tshogs kyi phyir rtag tu gtor ma byin na dbang dang / mngon spyod dang / dgra'i sde 'jig pa dang / bskrad pa dang / bsad pa dang / dgug pa dang / zhi ba dang / rgyas par yang 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ phyag rgya gang gis mkha' spyod ma/ /gang gis phyag rgyas sa spyod ma/ /gtso bo bdag gis sngar ma 'tshal/ /bcom ldan ji ltar phyag rgya bgyi/

/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /sku gsung thugs su phye ba las/ /steng dang 'og dang dbus gnas pa'i/ /'khor lo'i dbus su rnam par gnas/ /sa spyod sku yi phyag rgya can/ /steng zhal sku yi rdo rje ma/ /mkha' spyod 'dod chags phyag rgya can/ /'og zhal gsung gi rdo rje ma/ /thugs kyi rdo rje bdag med ma/ /sems can bdag med tshul can nyid/ /sems can dbus kyi gnas su ste/ /des na bdag med ma dbus skye/ /rgyas par rab tu phye ba las/ /rigs ni rnam pa drug tu brjod/ /rnam gsum rnam pa lnga nyid kyang / /bshad kyis rnal 'byor ma nyid nyon/ /mi bskyod rnam snang rin chen 'byung / /dpag med don grub rdo rje sems/ /zhe sdang gti mug ser sna dang / /'dod chags phrag dog bde ba dag /'dis ni rim pas bsgom pa nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' spangs na ni/ /phyi nas rigs ni rnam pa lnga/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /de rjes rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /mi bskyod zhe sdang gzugs can gyi/ /thugs kyi bdag po rigs gcig nyid/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i byin rlabs 'di/ /rigs ni drug dang lnga ru brjod/ /kyai rdo rje las rgyud thams cad kyi phyag rgya bsdus pa'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //(de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gtso bo kyai rdor kun sbyin pas/ /rnam kun rang bzhin bdag nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni yang dag gsungs/ /rnam pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis/ /bde ba can na yang dag bzhugs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i sa bon gyis/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ste/) bsgyur kha shas la med/ /phyag ni bcu drug zhal brgyad pa/ /zhabs bzhi pa la 'jigs pa po/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud/ /phyag rgya lnga ni 'dzin lha la/ /bdag med ma ni nyid kyis zhus/ /bco lngas yongs su bskor ba yi/

/bdag gi 'khor lo khyod bshad na/ /khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar lags/ /gtso bo bdag gis sngar ma 'tshal/ /bdag med ma la 'o mdzad nas/ /rdo rje thod par bstsal nas ni/ /lha yi nu ma mnye mdzad de/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag rab tu dbye/ /'khor lo ji ltar sngar gsungs pa/ /do shal do shal phyed pas brgyan/ /mtshams bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rdo rje srad bus yang dag brgyan/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin las/ /khyod dang lhan cig bzhin bzang ma/ /de la dbus su nga yod de/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /phyag ni bcu drug gis brgyan pa/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa nyid/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs pa'o/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal mdzad/ /nyi mar bzhugs shing rol mor bcas/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs pa po/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /nyid kyi zhal nas hūṃ spro zhing / /thal bas lus la byugs pa nyid/ /bdag med lhan cig mnyam sbyor zhing / /dga' ba gnyis gnyis snyoms 'jug pas/ /dba' rlabs med pa'i bde ba thob/ /rlom sems med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po che/ /g.yas pa la ni kun+da mtshungs/ /g.yon pa dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ /spyi bo'i zhal ni gtsigs pa can/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhis che/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba bzhin/ /grong khyer nyams dgar khyod dang nga / /dga' bas shin tu rol ba las/ /dkar mo dbang po'i phyogs phyung nas/ /shar gyi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /srub dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba las/ /chom rkun ma yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas lho yi sgo ru ni/ /chom rkun ma ni sgo srung ma/ /bo la kak+ko la sbyor bas/ /ro langs ma yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas nub kyi sgo ru ni/ /bdud 'joms ma ni rnam par gnas/ /dga' ba chen po'i snyoms 'jug las/ /ghasma rī yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas byang gi sgo la ni/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can ma nyid gnas/

/gnyis kyis bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /puk+ka sī yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas dbang ldan mtshams su yang / /drag po'i gzugs can ma nyid gnas/ /yang ni srub pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'tshed pa'i mtshams su ri khrod ma/ /srin po'i mtshams su gdol ba mo/ /rlung gi mtshams su g.yung mo nyid/ /de nas rdo rje chags chen las/ /rig mar bcas pa khu bar gyur/ /sna tshogs glu yi mchod pa las/ /de nas lha mo rnams kyis bskul/ /rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spangs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ /khyod med na ni bdag 'gums pas/ /kyai yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad rnams la/ /gnyis 'thung la sogs rim shes bya/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ /me dang zla ba nyi ma nyid/ /mthar byed dang ni nor sbyin nyid/ /g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na 'o/ /sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs rung ba/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yis/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /am̐ dang hūm̐ gis rdo rje che/ /khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhabs rnams sa la brdebs pa dang / /lha dang lha min bsdigs par mdzad/ /gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐/ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ 'di yis sa bon phyung ba las/ /bdag po'i sa bon dag gis ni/ /am̐ hūm̐ sngon po 'bar 'jigs pas/ /ma mo'i 'khor lo grong nyams dgar/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po/

/bdag med bde ba sbyin pa po/ /gtso bo 'di ltar bsgom pa nyid/ /dkar mo'i g.yas na gri gug ste/ /de bzhin g.yon na ro hi ta/ /chom rkun ma g.yas cang te'u ste/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na phag pa nyid/ /ro langs ma g.yas rus sbal te/ /g.yon pa yis ni pad+ma'i snod/ /ghasma rī yi g.yas na sprul/ /g.yon pas rnal 'byor lhung bzed nyid/ /puk+ka sī g.yas seng ge ste/ /g.yon pas dgra satwa de bzhin no/ /ri khrod ma g.yas dge slong ste/ /g.yon pas bsil byed de bzhin no/ /gdol ba mo g.yas 'khor lo ste/ /g.yon pas thod pa de bzhin no/ /g.yung mo g.yas na rdo rje nyid/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub de bzhin no/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gang gyis gnas/ /dkar mo la sogs phyag gnyis brjod/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du ste/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gau rī kha dog nag por 'gyur/ /tshom rkun ma ni btsod dang mtshungs/ /ro langs ma ni gser btsos bzhin/ /ghasma rī ni margad mtshungs/ /puk+ka sī ni dbang sngon mtshungs/ /ri khrod ma ni zla nor 'od/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo sangs ma/ /g.yung mo sna tshogs pa zhes brjod/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag /gshin rje dang ni nor bdag dang / /bden bral dang ni thags bzangs ris/ /gau rī la sogs pa yi gdan/ /bo la gzhib par mdzad nas ni/ /dam du 'khyud cing 'o mdzad pas/ /bcom ldan gus pas mchod nas ni/ /bdag med ma yis sngags zhus so/ /bud med rnams kyi dbang byed sngags/ /de bzhin gdug pa sdigs pa dang / /klu rnams sdigs par byed pa nyid/ /lha dang lha min rnam nyed pa/ /de ni nga yis bshad bya yis/ /lha mo bde ba sbyin ma nyon/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la/ /bdag gis gzhan du ma bstan to/ /'di yi sngags kyis gang byung zhing / /rdo rje sems dpas gang mdzad pa/ /lha mo shin tu 'jigs pa ste/ /ngo mi chog pas khyod la bshad/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrug pa yi/

/dkyil 'khor rab tu bzhengs nas ni/ /rdo rje snying po dbang sbyin phyir/ /thig le mchog ni bkug pa nyid/ /bzlas pa khri yis gsal ba dang / /sgra ring ba dang bzang ba yis/ /kyai yi rdo rje sbyor ldan pas/ /btsun mo thams cad dgug par bya/ /bzlas pa 'bum gyis rnal 'byor bdag /kyai yi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di yis las rnams thams cad byed/ /rig byed rnams kyi dang po sbyin/ /zla phyed thig les rnam par brgyan/ /de nas aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ /piṃg ur+dha ke sha brta ma ne/ tsa turbiṃ sha ti ni trā ya/ de'i rjes su/ ṣo ḍa sha bha ུdzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇā dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe ka pā la mā lā nai kadhā ri ṇe/ ā dha mā taḥ krū ra tsit+tā ya ar dhen du daṃ ṣ+ṭi ṇe/ om̐ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rān/ ban+dha ban+dha nā gā ṣ+ṭa kāṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sha trūṃ/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas lha mo de dgyes nas/ /srub dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba las/ /dam du 'khyud dang 'o byed pas/ /dkyil 'khor yid du 'ong ba zhus/ /de la ston pa ye shes che/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyar nas/ /dgyes pa'i thugs kyis mnyam bzhag pas/ /nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bri bar mdzad/ /'phar ma gcig dang sgo bzhi pa/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis yang dag 'khrugs/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje srad bus rnam par brgyan/ /re khā lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /de nas bum pa brgyad po bri/ /rin chen lnga yi phye ma 'am/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pa yi/ /dur khrod kyi ni so phag gam/ /de bzhin dur khrod sol ba yis/ /de dbus pad+ma 'dab ma ni/ /brgyad pa ze bar bcas pa bri/ /snying por skyes pa'i thod pa nyid/ /mdog dkar cha ni gsum pa bri/ /dbang ldan du ni sha ra bha/ /me yi mtshams su dge slong bri/

/bden bral du ni 'khor lo bri/ /rlung du rigs kyi bdag po bri/ /shar sgor de bzhin gri gug nyid/ /lho ru cang te'u bri ba nyid/ /nub tu rus sbal bri ba nyid/ /lto 'phye byang du de bzhin no/ /lha mo'i kha dog dbye ba yis/ /phyag mtshan brgyad du rab tu grags/ /dbus su thod pa dkar po yang / /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ /de nas rnam rgyal bum pa nyid/ /yal ga'i rtse mo gos bzang can/ /lto ba rin chen lngas gang ba/ /sā lu skyes pas yongs bkang bzhag /mang du rab tu brjod pas ci/ /ji ltar de nyid bsdus pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga de bzhin bya/ /bcu gnyis brgyad gnyis lon pa yi/ /rig ma bde chen brgyad po nyid/ /do shal rkang gdub kyis brgyan nas/ /dkyil 'khor du ni rab tu gzhug /ma dang sring mo nyid dang yang / /bu mo sring mo tsha mo dang / /de bzhin zhang po'i chung ma dang / /ma yi spun dang sgyug mo dang / /de bzhin pha yi sring mo nyid/ /rig ma brgyad du rab tu grags/ /dam du 'khyud dang 'o byed pas/ /'di rnams rnal 'byor pa yis mchod/ /de las ga pur btung ba nyid/ /des ni dkyil 'khor bsang gtor bya/ /de rnams rnal 'byor pas btung bya/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /de la chang yang btung ba dang / /sha dang sā lu skyes pa bza'/ /de yang gos dang bral byas nas/ /bha gar 'o ni yang yang bya/ /des kyang bol+la gzhib par bya/ /gar bya glu yang blang bar bya/ /bol+la kak+ko la sbyar nas/ /de la rtsed mo rtse bar bya/ /de nas thun tshod gnyis pa la/ /gos kyis mig ni bkab nas su/ /der ni slob ma gzhug pa nyid/ /phyi nas dkyil 'khor rab tu bstan/ /mtshan mo skye bo med khyim du/ /slob dpon la sogs rab phye nas/ /dbang ni ji ltar gsungs pa nyid/ /de la dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /ji ltar mchod dang bstod bshad pa/ /slob ma bzang pos sngar shes bya/ /de la de nyid bstan pa ni/

/dga' bral dang po mchog mtha' can/ /thams cad rgyud du sbas pa ste/ /mtha' yi mtha' ru phye ba nyid/ /rdo rje mchod pa rab sbyar nas/ /de la lha mo des zhus pa/ /lha de'i skad cig ji ltar lags/ /gtso bo chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /der ni thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa nyid/ /longs spyod kyi ni rlabs gnyis la/ /rang gi g.yas dang lag gzhan gyi/ /mthe bong dang ni srin lag gis/ /de ni rnal 'byor pa yis btsir/ /de nas ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /de las ci zhig skye zhe na/ /gzhon nu'i dga' ba ji lta 'am/ /lkugs pa'i rmi lam ji lta 'o/ /mchog gi mtha' dang dga' bral dbus/ /stong dang stong min he ru ka /kyai rdo rje las kyai rdo rje mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //lha mo la ni dam 'khyud cing / /bol+la thod par bcug nas ni/ /dam du nu ma bzung mdzad nas/ /skyes pa'i sna ni gzhibs nas kyang / /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir nas ni/ /mchan khung sen mos rma mdzad de/ /mnyam sbyor bde ba myong mdzad nas/ /phyag rgya lnga ni rnam phye ba/ /bla ma slob dpon 'dod lha la/ /phyag 'tshal don du 'khor lo 'dzin/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /smod tshig mi nyan pa yi phyir/ /rna ba dag tu rna cha 'dzin/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa mgul rgyan nyid/ /gdu bu srog chags gsod pa spangs/ /phyag rgya bsten pa ska rags nyid/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi phyag rgyas ni/ /rtag tu lus la phyag rgyas gdab/ /de nas rab tu bzhad mdzad nas/ /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir nas ni/ /kyai yi rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs can nyid/ /de la lha mo des zhus pa/ /gtso bo cho ga gang gis dang / /de bzhin bya ba gang gis ni/ /kyai rdo rje yi bris sku ni/ /byed pa bde ba chen pos gsungs/

/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'dir ni 'bri mkhan dam tshig can/ /sgrub po'ang dam tshig can gyis ni/ /bris sku 'jigs pa bri ba nyid/ /skyes pa'i thod gnas kha dog lnga/ /ro yi skra yi pir nyid kyis/ /bris sku bla ma bri ba nyid/ /gang gang skud pa 'khal ba dang / /gang gang ras yug 'thag pa yang / /de yang dam tshig can nges pas/ /dam tshig byin rlabs rnal 'byor pas/ /zla ba zla ba'i mar ngo yi/ /bcu bzhi pa la khyim dben par/ /byed na ma rungs sems kyis ni/ /chang gi btung ba cung zad las/ /lus la ni ram̐ shu bsams nas/ /de bzhin gcer bur gyur pas kyang / /'bags pa dang ni ma dag pas/ /de nas dam tshig rab tu bza'/ /bzhin bzangs snying rje ldan pa dang / /gzugs dang lang tsho skal bzang ma/ /me tog bcas shing sgrub por dga'/ /rang gi phyag rgya g.yon du gzhag /kyai rdo rje las bris sku'i cho ga'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas de la lha mos zhus/ /bol+la kak+ko la sbyar nas/ /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir nas ni/ /glegs bam yang ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyar nas/ /dgyes pas lha yis rab phye ba/ /glegs bam nga yis bshad bya yis/ /lha mo skal ba chen mo nyon/ /sbrang chen snag tsha byas nas ni/ /mi yi rus pa'i smyu gus ni/ /glegs bam sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /gro gar dam tshig can gyis bri/ /glegs bam dang ni bris sku nyid/ /gal te skal med mthong na ni/ /skye ba 'dir ni dngos grub med/ /'jig rten pha rol spyod yul min/ /yang dag rab sbyin ldan pa la/ /res 'ga' tsam zhig bstan pa nyid/ /glegs bam lam gyi spyod yul du/ /skra dang mchan khung nyid du sba/ /bha gar liṅga rab bzhag nas/ /yang dang yang du 'o mdzad nas/ /bde chen mnyam par myong mdzad de/ /rdo rje can gyis bza' ba bstan/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bza' ba ni/ /nyon cig lha mo mig yangs ma/ /gang du zos pas 'dod don kun/

/sgrub pa can gyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /dur khrod ri yi bya skyibs dang / /de bzhin mi med grong khyer dang / /yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /bza' ba 'di ni rab tu bza'/ /de la gdan du brtag pa ni/ /ro yi gzugs can dgu dang ni/ /yang na stag gi pags pa dang / /dur khrod ras ni de bzhin no/ /dbus su kyai rdo rje yi gzugs/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin gnas shes nas/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral dag tu yang / /de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams dgod/ /dam tshig mā la tin+dā naṃ/ /stag gi pags pa'i steng du bza'/ /'bad pas rgyal po sā lu yi/ /bza' ba der ni bza' ba nyid/ /der ni zos nas zos nas kyang / /der ni ma mo mchod par bya/ /sring mo bu mo sgyug mo dang / /gal te ma sring yin na yang / /de rnams rtag tu legs mchod na/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub par 'gyur/ /skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig par/ /chang ni bzang pos yongs bkang ste/ /bla ma la dbul skal chen ma/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni rang yang btung / /pad+ma'i lag pas blangs pa dang / /de nyid kyi ni lag pas dbul/ /yang nas yang du rab 'dud pa/ /de ltar sgrub pa po yis bya/ /kyai rdo rje las bza' ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor mas zhus pa/ /phyag rgya chen po ji lta bu/ /kun rdzob rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bde ba sbyin pas bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /shin tu ring min thung ba min/ /gnag pa ma yin dkar ba min/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i rnam pa 'dra/ /de yi dbugs ni dri zhim ldan/ /rdul kyang dri zhing ldan 'gyur te/ /ri dwags lte ba'i dri dang mtshungs/ /pad+ma la yang dbang mchog dri/ /skad cig pad+ma lta bu 'byung / /de yi ga pur sih+la dag /mkhas pas dri bzang mtshon par bya/ /ut+pa la yi drir 'gyur zhing / /a ka ru ni nag po mtshungs/ /dal zhing mi g.yo ba nyid dang / /snyan par smra zhing yid 'ong ma/ /skra bzang dbus su gnyer ma gsum/

/phal pas pad+ma can du brjod/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs can ma/ /de rnyed nas ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma bdag med mas gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das smon lam ji ltar gdab par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam bzas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /de nas lha mo de dgyes nas/ /tshig ni 'di nyid yang zhus pa/ /skal med sems can gdul dka' ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur pa lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ /de yi rjes la dbu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai yi rdo rje bstan/ /slob mas gus par blangs nas ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /kyai'i rdo rje las 'dul ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas kha sbyar 'byed pa yi/ /mtshan nyid yang dag rab tu bshad/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sgrub pos dngos grub thob 'gyur ba/ /bsgrub bya'i lte ba'i rtsa ba la/ /brtul zhugs can gyi lag pas gdon/ /he ru ka mnyam rnal 'byor gyis/ /nang gis ma rungs sems kyis ni/ /'di ni bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni nges par 'jig /bstan la gnod pa byed pa dang / /bla ma sangs rgyas 'jig pa ni/ bla ma thub pa la zhus nas/ /snying rjes gsad par bya ba nyid/ /ji ltar phyugs kyi gzugs mthong nas/ /khrag ni skyugs pa nyid dang yang / /'dar zhing mgo skyes grol ba dang / /kha ni 'og tu rnam par sgom/ /de yi lam du khab ni me'i/

/gzugs can 'jug par bsam pa ste/ /snying gar byin za'i sa bon nyid/ /dmigs nas skad cig gsod par byed/ /rgyud 'di la ni sreg blugs med/ /phyag rgya bcing dang bya ba'ang med/ /rgyud chen bklags pas 'grub pa nyid/ /bsam gtan tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtog med dngos grub sbyin pa po/ /srid pa sbyong ba nyams dga' bar/ /gsang ba mchog ni bshad bya yis/ /nyon cig lha mo bzhin bzang ma/ /rin chen gzi brjid 'bar ba yi/ /phreng ba 'khrugs pa lha mo ltos/ /ma phug pas ni sbyor bral 'gyur/ /phug pas dga' ba sbyin pa 'o/ de ltar 'khor bar 'dod pa yi/ /yon tan lnga ldan rin chen nyid/ /ma dag pas ni dug tu 'gro/ /dag pas bdud rtsi lta bur 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i rnam pa he ru ka /'gro ba sgrol ba'i gtso bo nyid/ /gang gi gzugs kyis 'gyur ba nyid/ /de ni nga yis smra yi nyon/ /snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ /byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu pa'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /sha ni puk+ka sī ru brjod/ /de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma/ /gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod/ /g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid/ /bdag med mas gsol ba/ sngags btu ba ni ji ltar 'gyur/ gang gi sngags kyis skye bo yi/ /las kyi dngos grub 'gyur ba nyid/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can chen po/ rdo rje snying po gzi brjid chen pos bka' stsal pa/ sngags ni khyod la ngas bshad kyis/ /lha mo shes rab chen mo nyon/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad sbyin/ /uṣ+mā rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /puk+ka sīs brgyan stong pas mnan/ /mdog dkar mthar ni swā hā sbyar/

/'dis ni bzlas pa 'bum gyis ni/ /'gro ba rtag tu rengs par byed/ /dang por yi ge'i bdag po bzhag /de rjes mkha' spyod ma de nas/ /mthar ni swā hā sbyar byas nas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang dbang du byed/ /rig byed rnams kyi dang po sbyin/ /dang po yi ni gnyis pa la/ /stong bcas mtha' ni swā hā sbyar/ /sangs rgyas kyang skrod shes rab can/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad sbyin/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /rwa dang ldan zhing chu mas brgyan/ /stong bcas swā hā yang dag ldan/ /mi rnams thams cad sdang bar byed/ /dang po yi ge'i dbang phyug bzhag /lnga pa nyid kyi gsum pa la/ /stong pa mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/ /mthar ni swā hā mngon spyod che/ /yang ni yi ge'i thu bo sbyin/ /hūm̐ ni khrag dang 'dra ba yi/ /mthar ni swā hā thig le mchog /dga' bzang ma sogs rtag tu 'gugs/ /gti mug rigs ni dang por sbyin/ /ghū ni yang dag rab tu sbyar/ /mthar ni swā hā yang byas na/ /lha dang mi rnams gsod par byed/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad bzhag /dang po nyid kyi dang po la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang sbyar/ /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/ /yang na dang po'i rtse mo la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang ldan/ /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa la/ /yang ni de nyid yang dag ldan/ /steng du chom rkun ma yis brgyan/ /de rjes hrīḥyis rnam par sbyar/ /mthar yang swā hā spyod pa nyid/ /ku ru kul+le'i sngags so/ /om̐ ni dang po bzhi pa yi/ /gsum pa chom rkun ma yis brgyan/ /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa la/ /pi tsu badz+ra sbyar pa dang / /uṣ+mā rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /puk+ka sī yis rnam par brgyan/ /stong pas mnan cing sum 'gyur nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa'i dang po mthar swā hā/ /kyai'i rdo rje snying po'o/ /snang mdzad dang por dz+wa la gnyis/ /sbyar nas lnga pa'i bzhi pa la/ /mthar gnas rnams kyi dang po ldan/

/ghasma rīs ni rnam par brgyan/ /uṣ+mā rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yis brgyan/ /stong pas mnan cing sum 'gyur nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa'i dang po mthar swā hā/ /phyag bzhi pa'i sngags so/ /dang por rnam snang dang po yi/ /dang po nang gi dkar mos brgyan/ /gsum pa nyid kyi dang po la/ /nang gi dkar mos rnam par brgyan/ /nyis 'gyur lnga pa'i gsum pa dang / /gnyis pa'i gsum pa me yis brgyan/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa gsum sbyar nas/ /lnga pa nyid kyi gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa'i dang po mthar swā hā/ /phyag drug pa'i sngags so/ /dang po rnam snang bzhi pa yi/ /dang po byin za yang dag ldan/ /ro langs ma yis rnam par brgyan/ /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa la/ /ghasma rī yis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po yi ni dang po la/ /mthar gnas pa yi dang po dang / /rdo rje ma yis rnam par brgyan/ k+ṣa ni chom rkun ma yis brgyan/ /lnga pa nyid kyi dang po dang / /uṣ+mā rnams kyi bzhi pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yis brgyan/ /stong pas mnan cing sum 'gyur te/ /phaṭ dang mthar ni swā hā nyid/ /phyag gnyis pa'i sngags so/ /bdag med dang po'i dang po dang / /gnyis pa nyid kyi dang po dang / /gsum pa nyid kyi dang po dang / /bzhi pa yi ni dang po dang / /lnga pa yi ni dang po dang / /mthar gnas rnams kyi dang po dang / /uṣ+mū rnams kyi dang po nyid/ /dang por rnam snang mthar swā hā/ /grong khyer dkrug pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa ni 'bum mo/ /mthar gnas rnams kyi gnyis pa dang / /k+ṣa yi rnam pa nyis 'gyur nyid/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa gsum dang ldan/ /dang por rnam snang phaṭ nyid kyi/ /rnam pa nang bcug mthar swā hā/ /sa sbyangs pa'i sngags so/ /dang por rnam snang de rjes su/ /rdo rje ma yi mtha' ru hā/ /bza' ba dang btung ba byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ /de rjes a ka ro mu kham̐/ /uṣ+mā rnams kyi gsum pa dang /

/mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa ni/ /steng du me yis rnam par brgyan/ /dharmā ṇām̐ de rjes rdo rje ma/ /byin la dra nut+pan+na twā ta/ /om̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ /'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /kyai'i rdo rje las sngags btu ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas chos kun sdom gcig pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byas gsungs/ /bdag med ma la 'o mdzad nas/ /bzlas pa'i yul ni rab tu dbye/ /shel gyis rengs pa'i bzlas pa nyid/ /dbang la tsan+dan dmar po nyid/ /lung tang gis ni mngon spyod nyid/ /ni raṃ shus ni sdang ba la/ /rta yi rus pas skrod pa nyid/ /bram ze'i rus pas 'gugs pa nyid/ /glang po'i rus pas char pa la/ /ma he yis kyang gsad pa la/ /rengs pa 'o ma'i btung ba nyid/ /dbang la rang gi 'dun pas spyad/ /gsad pa la ni sih+la nyid/ /dgug pa la ni bzhi mnyam nyid/ /sdang la swā lu skyes pa brjod/ /bskrad pa nyid la gla rtsir brjod/ /yang na mtha'i shwa dang / dang po'i shwa dang / na dang po dang / ga dang po dang / ha dang po nyid kyang de bzhin no/ /kyai'i rdo rje las bzlas pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //kyai'i rdo rje la dam 'khyud cing / /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir nas ni/ /lus can rnams kyi rigs kyi gzugs/ /de la bdag med mas zhus pa/ /bha gar liṅga gzhag nas ni/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pas 'di skad gsungs/ /lus can rang gi rigs bshad kyis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma nyon/ /bud med dam ni skyes pa yi/ /gang gi srin lag rtsa ba la/ /rdo rje rtse dgu par gyur pa/ /mi bskyod pa yi rigs mchog nyid/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi 'khor lor 'gyur/ /dpag med mgon gyi 'dam skyes nyid/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i rin chen nyid/ /las kyi rigs kyi ral gri nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa gang nag po che/ /de yi lha ni mi bskyod pa/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar po che/ /de yi lha ni rnam snang mdzad/ /rnal 'byor pa gang sngo bsangs che/

/de yi lha ni don yod nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa gang ser po che/ /rin chen bdag po rigs kyi lha/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar dmar nyid/ /'od dpag med pa rigs kyi lha/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar dang ser/ /de ni sems dpa'i rigs su 'gyur/ /skye bo rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas/ /nga rgyal mi bcag tho mi 'tsham/ /kun rdzob gzugs su gnas nas ni/ /de rnams bde gshegs rigs su 'gyur/ /bud med rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /ji ltar skyes pa de bzhin no/ /kun rdzob tha snyad tshul las ni/ /de yi rigs su'ang de 'gyur ro/ /bha gar liṅga'i 'o mdzad nas/ /de la rdo rje che mnyes nas/ /bdag med ma yis go mdzad pa/ /lha mor rab tu mchod pa nyon/ /tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang / /bdag gi khyim gyi nang du yang / /gcer bu phyag rgya cher byas nas/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /'o dang 'khyud pa byas nas ni/ /de bzhin bha gar reg pa nyid/ /skyes pa'i sna ni gzhib pa nyid/ /ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi btung ba nyid/ /rtag tu myos pa'i mtshan ma las/ /bol+la ldan pas lag pas bya/ /khyogs dang brla zhes bya ba dang / /de bzhin shin tu bkal ba yi/ /yang yang rdo rjes 'dod pa bya/ /steng dang 'og tu lta ba nyid/ /dngos grub rgyas pa thob pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de la ga pur btung bar bya/ /de la ga pur rgyu yi phyir/ /sha ni bza' ba nyid du bya/ /khyad par du ni chang nyid do/ /kyai'i rdo rje las lhan cig skyes pa'i sbyor ba don gyi le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas rdo rje can gyi dbang / /bzhi pa'i tshigs bcad bka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid/ /che dang dril bu chen po bzung / /de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur/ /slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ba/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/

/sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral thar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags ni/ om̐ pad+ma su khā dhā ra mahā rā ga su khaṃ da da tsatu rā nan+da bhā ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ om̐ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa tsa turā nan+da dā ya kaḥkha ga mu khai ka ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ spyi bor ni om̐ gyi rnam pa/ snying gar ni hūm̐ gi rnam pa/ ze'u 'bru la ni āḥ'i rnam pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu ma'i brtag pa zhes bya ba brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis las phyung ba brtag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid kyai rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo ts+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 56 rdo rje 'chang / dpal kyai rdo rje'i zhes bya'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs so/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 57
